whatsNew.en-AU:
Changes since 1.0.6:

• Reminder setup on iOS no longer hangs on Checking. Notification permission checks time out with a retry option, and Settings rechecks permissions after you authorise a collection or return to the app.
• Collection names and locations load independently of task counts; if a collection summary can't be read you see an error with a retry option instead of the app staying on Opening.
• Opening Scratchpad no longer creates a new current note each time on collections using newer mdbase versions, and Scratchpad notes can now be deleted.
• A refreshed, more consistent colour palette with clearer accent, success and danger colours in light and dark themes.
• Each view in navigation has its own icon, so views such as Today, Projects, Archive, Upcoming and Calendar are easier to tell apart.
• Quieter task rows and Scratchpad, with lighter dividers.

reviewNotes:
TaskNotes 1.0.7 update

REVIEW ACCESS
No login credentials or sample files are required to review the included demo. On a fresh installation, choose "Try a disposable demo" on the opening screen. This opens an included in-memory collection populated with sample tasks. Demo changes are intentionally discarded when the app restarts. Connecting a persistent mdbase collection is optional and requires the user to authorize access.

CHANGES IN THIS UPDATE
iOS reminder initialization no longer hangs; notification permission checks time out with a retry action and are rechecked after authorization changes and app resume. Collection summaries load independently and show a retry action on failure instead of remaining on Opening. Scratchpad no longer creates a new current note on every open for collections using newer mdbase versions, and notes can be deleted. The colour palette is unified with clearer accent, success and danger colours in light and dark themes while keeping text contrast at or above 4.5:1. Navigation uses a distinct icon for each view. Task rows and Scratchpad use lighter dividers.

FUNCTIONS AND AUDIENCE
TaskNotes is a task manager for people who want portable structured Markdown records. Users can capture, edit, complete, search, assign and reorder tasks; set dates, priorities, recurrence, reminders and time estimates; use lists, boards and calendars; attach images; and turn Scratchpad notes into tasks.

OPTIONAL SERVICES
mdbase provides access to an authorized persistent collection and reminder timers. Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification service deliver content-free reminder notifications after explicit opt-in. The disposable demo does not require an account or external collection.
